title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cedarville University
description: Cedarville's late-night scene is defined by on-campus hubs and local mainstays that cater to students after hours. From the central student center to the classic dairy bar, these spots provide the fuel for late study sessions and social gatherings in this close-knit community.

cards.title: The Commons Express
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pizza and Tacos in the SSC
cards.notes: Located in the Stevens Student Center, this spot serves pizza and tacos until 11:00 PM most nights for students with late cravings.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus late-night dining option in the Stevens Student Center offering pizza and tacos.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Express is open Sunday through Friday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Friday; closed on Saturdays.

cards.title: The Commons Market
cards.subtitle: Campus Convenience Store
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks, drinks, and frozen foods at this SSC convenience store, which stays open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store in the Stevens Student Center providing snacks and essentials until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Market is open until 11:00 PM every day of the week.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc

cards.entity_name: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill
cards.title: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: Classic Ice Cream and Burgers
cards.notes: A local favorite for over 50 flavors of ice cream and custom burgers, serving the community until 11:00 PM most nights.
cards.short_summary: A beloved local dairy bar in Cedarville known for its extensive ice cream selection and late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill is open Monday through Saturday from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu/Ordering | Mom and Dad's Dairy Bar and Grill
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Monday-Saturday and 10:00 PM on Sunday.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A
cards.subtitle: Lakeside Dining and Study Spot
cards.notes: Located near the library, this popular spot offers meals and a scenic study space overlooking Cedar Lake until 9:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Chick-fil-A location that serves as a common evening meeting and study spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A on campus is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Panda Express
cards.subtitle: SSC Lower Level Dining
cards.notes: Find American Chinese favorites in the heart of campus at the Stevens Student Center, open until 9:00 PM for dinner runs.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Panda Express located in the lower level of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Panda Express is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: The Cafe
cards.subtitle: Healthy Options in Scharnberg
cards.notes: Located in the Scharnberg Center, The Cafe offers flatbreads and power bowls until 9:00 PM on weekdays and Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A newer campus dining venue in the Scharnberg Business and Communication Center with evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cafe is open until 9:00 PM Monday through Friday and on Sundays.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Mon-Fri and Sun; closed on Saturdays.

cards.title: Tossed
cards.subtitle: Salads and Wraps by the Lake
cards.notes: Next to Chick-fil-A, Tossed provides fresh salads and pizzas until 9:00 PM, making it a staple for evening campus meals.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus eatery specializing in salads, wraps, and pizzas with evening availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Tossed is open Monday through Saturday until 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Menu & Service Hours – Cedarville University - Pioneer College Caterers, Inc
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Colonial Pizza
cards.subtitle: Downtown Pizza and Subs
cards.notes: A family-owned downtown staple known for fresh pizza and baked subs, often visited by students for evening group dinners.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza parlor in downtown Cedarville popular for its Italian dishes and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Colonial Pizza is a family-owned favorite in the heart of downtown Cedarville.
cards.source_title: On-Campus and Local Dining Options | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Check local listings for current evening closing times.

cards.title: Centennial Library
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Study Hub
cards.notes: The primary destination for serious late-night studying, offering quiet zones and group tables for students.
cards.short_summary: The main university library, which serves as a central hub for student academic work into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centennial Library is a favorite place on campus for studying, featuring quiet zones and group tables.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Check library website for current semester late-night closing hours.

cards.title: Rinnova Coffee
cards.subtitle: Campus Coffee Shop
cards.notes: Located in the lower SSC, Rinnova is the go-to for evening caffeine runs and social study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's full-service campus coffee shop located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rinnova is Cedarville's full-service coffee shop located inside the lower entrance of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.source_title: On-Campus and Local Dining Options | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM on weekdays; check for extended hours during finals or special events.
